title: Listen and Choose a Response — Errands

questions.stem: I'm going to the grocery store. Do you need anything?

options.A: I went to the grocery store yesterday.
options.B: Could you pick up some eggs and a loaf of bread?
options.C: The store is about ten minutes away.
options.D: No, I don't need to go there.

questions.explanation: Answering an offer with a specific request is natural. The other choices change the tense, answer where, or misunderstand who is going.
questions.speaker: f3
